symptom: describe microflow printed `$variable = call microflow M.VoidSub(…)` for a call whose callee returns nothing; check passed the same statement and exec stored UseReturnVariable=true, ResultVariableName=variable.
cause: The call formatter printed the stored ResultVariableName whenever UseReturnVariable was set, without asking whether the callee returns anything; the flow builder stored whatever name the statement gave. Studio Pro leaves that name behind when a flow stops returning a value.
fix: describedCallIsVoid (voidCodeActions.resolveFlow, memoised on the describe's flowAnalysisMemo) drops the assignment for a callee KNOWN to return nothing; storedResultVariable writes none for a Void return type; MDL096 warns on `$X = call microflow/nanoflow` to a known-void flow. Unknown callee keeps the name everywhere.
insight: The void-call resolver from #953/#962 already answered this question for MDL063/MDL093; the gap was that describe and the builder never asked it. Known-void vs unknown must stay distinct: nil from lookupMicroflowReturnType means not found, VoidType means returns nothing. Verified on mx 11.12.6: 0 errors, and the description re-runs Unchanged.
test: mdl/executor/void_flow_call_result_2138_test.go (describe, storedResultVariable, MDL096; controls: returns a value, callee unknown, no result)
